{{Top|leg}}
A '''credit pouch''' was a receptacle used by individuals to carry their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] around. While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], two [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]] attempted to intimidate members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] into handing over their credit pouches, picking on those of the group who seemed to be non-combatants. They were detered by other members of the Rebel group.<ref name="TM-CA3">{{WEGCite|story=Tatooine Manhunt|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three}}</ref>
